$comment: What the images hold besides dpkg's packages and the scanners venv, with the licence texts each must carry. container/licenses.mjs copies them into /usr/share/licenses/commitwork at build time and fails the build when one is missing. A `path` is read in the image; an `archive` file is the one setup took from the release archive it verified; a `tree` file is vendored under container/licenses/ from `upstream` at the pinned tag and must match `sha256`.

components.name: commitwork
components.note: LICENSING.md: AGPL-3.0-or-later, or PolyForm Internal Use by written agreement, with the wire layer under Apache-2.0. The tree is JavaScript, so the image carries its own source.

components.name: node
components.note: The file carries, after Node's own licence, the licences of what Node bundles, npm (Artistic-2.0) and corepack (MIT) among them. npm's own dependencies carry theirs in place under /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/node_modules.

components.name: node-docker
components.note: docker-entrypoint.sh, from the official image's build repository.

components.name: trufflehog
components.note: A static Go binary: its corresponding source includes the Go modules it links, which the bundle carries.

components.name: cosign
components.note: Copied from sigstore's image, which carries no licence file; the upstream repository has no NOTICE at this tag.

components.name: actions-runner
components.note: The release archive carries no licence file.

components.name: dotnet-runtime
components.note: Microsoft.NETCore.App, bundled self-contained in the runner archive. THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT covers the code the runtime takes from others.

python.$comment: The scanners venv. A package whose dist-info carries no licence file gets one here, pinned to the version the lock installs. A copyleft package's source is its PyPI sdist unless `sources` names others.

licences.$comment: Packages whose metadata names no licence, as their licence file reads.

semgrep.why: the sdist holds the Python CLI; semgrep-core, the OCaml binary in the wheel, is built from the repository

flawfinder.why: PyPI has no sdist for 2.0.20; the wheel is the Python source itself
